title: Exit Fee Taken from a HomeFlood Cancellation Credit
content:
**Rule.** An exit fee is taken from the credit when a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy is cancelled on the named insured's signed request. The fee is scaled to how long the policy had been in force on the request's effective date, counted in whole calendar months from the policy's effective date.

| In force on the request's effective date | Exit fee |
|---|---|
| at least 60 whole months | none |
| at least 12 but fewer than 60 whole months | 15 USD |
| fewer than 12 whole months | 35 USD |

A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

**How the fee is taken.** The fee is an amount taken off after the shares and percents of the premium return have been applied.

## Boundary cases (policy effective 5 June)

| Request effective | Whole months in force | Exit fee |
|---|---|---|
| 4 June the following year | 11 | 35 |
| 5 June the following year | 12 | 15 |
| 4 June five years later | 59 | 15 |
| 5 June five years later | 60 | none |
